AbyssPage_bushetiaozhan.en:
No limit for challenge times. The challenge will be closed at 24:00. Select not to revive when you've killed or select to exit at the pause interface and back to the main menu will save your progress.
You can choose one Buff for every 10 levels. There's one Boss level in every 20 levels. The effect will double when you choose the Buff after the Boss level clearance.
All allies will be revived with the Buff. At the same time, Debuff will be removed, HP will be recovered, and CD will be refreshed.
There are 120s for each level. You will be sent back once the time you spent exceeds the limit.
When the time consumed is less than 5s/10s/15s, you can skip 3/2/1 level(s) respectively (Buff selecting and Boss level excluded). You will get Pagoda Coin x100 in each level, which will be sent to you 24:00 the day.
AbyssPage_bushetiaozhan.tw:
不設挑戰次數限制，24點強制結算，陣亡後選擇不復活或暫停介面選擇放棄後回到主菜單同時保存進度

選擇BUFF後全隊復活，去除debuff，狀態回滿，CD刷新
每關有120秒的挑戰時間，超時後強制遣返
當通過關卡所用時間小於5s/10s/15s時
，將會跳過3/2/1關，不會跳過BUFF選擇和BOSS關
每層掉落100塔幣，24點發放

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810004.tw: 友方角色每次使用武器攻擊時(除自動攻擊類武器外)有1%的概率在目標位置產生黑洞，吸附周圍敵人並使黑洞範圍內敵人受到的傷害提高20%，持續3秒

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810005.cn: 站立不动5秒后，友方全体造成的伤害增加35%，移动后效果还会持续2秒
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810005.en: After standing still for 5s, increase the DMG dealt by all allies by 35%, and the effect will last for 2s after you start moving.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810005.tw: 站立不動5秒後，友方全體造成的傷害增加35%，移動後效果還會持續2秒

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810006.cn: 宠物每次造成伤害都会使友方全体爆伤提高2%，最高提升到300%，持续5秒(持续时间可刷新)
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810006.en: When the pet attacks, increase all allies' Crit. DMG dealt by 2% (up to 350%), lasting for 5s (the duration can be refreshed).
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810006.tw: 寵物每次造成傷害都會使友方全體爆傷提高2%，最高提升到350%，持續5秒(持續時間可刷新)

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810007.cn: 使用武器攻击时(除自动攻击类武器外)，有5%的概率在敌人身上附加神圣结晶并碎裂，神圣结晶碎裂会造成8000%武器攻击力*技能强度的伤害
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810007.en: When attacking with weapons (except for auto-attack weapons), there's a 5% chance of attaching a Sacred Crystal on enemies and shattering it, dealing DMG equal to 8,000% Weapon ATK * Strength.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810007.tw: 使用武器攻擊時(除自動攻擊類武器外)，有5%的概率在敵人身上附加神聖結晶並碎裂，神聖結晶碎裂會造成8000%武器攻擊力*技能強度的傷害。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810008.cn: 角色每次释放技能时，会使自身攻击力提高5%，爆伤提高30%，最多可叠加6次，持续8秒
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810008.en: Each time a character releases a skill, increase their ATK by 5% and Crit. DMG by 30%, which can stack up to 6 times, lasting for 8s.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810008.tw: 角色每次釋放技能時，會使自身攻擊力提高5%，爆傷提高30%，最多可疊加6次，持續8秒。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810009.cn: 角色每次释放技能时，使所有宠物的技能伤害提高20%，最多可叠加5次，持续10秒
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810009.en: Each time a character releases a skill, increase all pets' Skill DMG by 20%, which can stack up to 5 times, lasting for 10s.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810009.tw: 角色每次釋放技能時，使所有寵物的技能傷害提高20%，最多可疊加5次，持續10秒。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810010.cn: 每10秒会随机扔出一个骰子，角色头顶会出现一个骰子，根据骰子投出的数量，骰子数字每高一点，所有召唤物造成的伤害提高8%，持续8秒
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810010.en: A dice will be randomly thrown every 10 seconds, and a dice will appear above the character's head. According to the number of dice thrown, the damage caused by all summoned objects will increase by 8% for each higher dice number, which lasts for 8 seconds.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810010.tw: 每10秒會隨機扔出一個骰子，角色頭頂會出現一個骰子，根據骰子投出的數量，骰子數字每高一點，所有召喚物造成的傷害提高8%，持續8秒。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810011.cn: 普攻造成伤害时有1%的几率将所有敌人变成煤球，持续5秒，敌人变成煤球后无法攻击，受到的伤害提高20%且移动速度降低50%，冷却时间10秒
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810011.en: When the weapon deals damage, there is a 1% chance to turn all enemies into briquettes for 5 seconds. After the enemy turns into briquettes, they cannot attack, the damage received is increased by 10% and the movement speed is reduced by 50%. The cooldown  time is 10 seconds.
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810011.tw: 武器造成傷害時有1%的幾率將所有敵人變成煤球，持續5秒，敵人變成煤球後無法攻擊，受到的傷害提高10%且移動速度降低50%，冷卻時間10秒。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810012.cn: 所有单位每存活10秒，就会让伤害提高10%，最多叠加3层
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810012.en: For every 20 seconds, every characters are still alive, damage will be increased by 5%. Stack up to 3 times
excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810012.tw: 所有單位每存活20秒，就會讓傷害提高5%，最多疊加3層。

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810013.cn: 角色复活后，该角色造成的伤害提高25%，持续5秒

excel_AbysspassiveSkill_Desc_810014.cn: 当有角色死亡时，所有敌方怪物受到的伤害提高30%，持续10秒(效果不可叠加)

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640003.tw: 移速提高固定值，受到的傷害減少x%

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640004.cn: 角色释放主动技能时眩晕所有怪物并使其受到的伤害提高10%，持续3秒(持续时间可刷新)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640004.en: When the character releases the active skill, stuns all monsters and increases the damage they receive by 10% for 3 seconds (the duration can be refreshed)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640004.tw: 角色釋放主動技能時眩暈所有怪物並使其受到的傷害提高10%，持續3秒(持續時間可刷新)

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640005.cn: 召唤物每次攻击都会使目标受到的所有伤害提高1%，最多叠加到20%，持续5秒(持续时间可刷新)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640005.en: Each attack of the summoned creature will increase all damage received by the target by 1%, up to a maximum of 20%, for 5 seconds (the duration can be refreshed)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640005.tw: 召喚物每次攻擊都會使目標受到的所有傷害提高1%，最多疊加到20%，持續5秒(持續時間可刷新)

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640006.cn: 每过20秒，会有50%的几率刷新所有技能cd
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640006.en: Every 20 seconds, there will be a 50% chance to refresh all skill CDs
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640006.tw: 每過20秒，會有50%的幾率刷新所有技能cd

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640007.cn: 友方角色每次使用武器攻击时(除自动攻击类武器外)有1%的概率在目标位置产生黑洞，吸附周围敌人并使黑洞范围内敌人受到的伤害提高10%，持续3秒，冷却时间10秒
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640007.en: Every time a friendly character uses a weapon to attack (except automatic attack weapons), there is a 1% chance that a black hole will be generated at the target position, absorbing surrounding enemies and increasing the damage received by enemies within the black hole range by 10%, lasting for 3 seconds, cooldown time 10 seconds
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640007.tw: 友方角色每次使用武器攻擊時(除自動攻擊類武器外)有1%的概率在目標位置產生黑洞，吸附周圍敵人並使黑洞範圍內敵人受到的傷害提高10%，持續3秒，冷卻時間10秒

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640008.cn: 站立不动5秒后，友方全体造成的伤害增加15%，移动后效果还会持续2秒
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640008.en: After standing still for 5 seconds, the damage dealt by all allies increases by 15%, and the effect lasts for 2 seconds after moving
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640008.tw: 站立不動5秒後，友方全體造成的傷害增加15%，移動後效果還會持續2秒

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640009.cn: 宠物每次造成伤害都会使友方全体爆伤提高0.5%，最高提升到100%，持续5秒(持续时间可刷新)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640009.en: Every time a pet inflicts damage, it will increase the critical damage of all allies by 0.5%, up to 100%, for 5 seconds (the duration can be refreshed)
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640009.tw: 寵物每次造成傷害都會使友方全體爆傷提高0.5%，最高提升到100%，持續5秒(持續時間可刷新)

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640010.cn: 使用武器攻击时(除自动攻击类武器外)，有5%的概率在敌人身上附加神圣结晶并碎裂，神圣结晶碎裂会造成8000%武器攻击力*技能强度的伤害。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640010.en: When attacking with a weapon (except automatic attack weapons), there is a 5% chance to add a holy crystal to the enemy and shatter it. The shattering of the holy crystal will cause damage equal to 8000% weapon attack power * skill strength.
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640010.tw: 使用武器攻擊時(除自動攻擊類武器外)，有5%的概率在敵人身上附加神聖結晶並碎裂，神聖結晶碎裂會造成8000%武器攻擊力*技能強度的傷害。

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640011.cn: 角色每次释放技能时，会使自身攻击力提高3%，爆伤提高10%，最多可叠加6次，持续8秒。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640011.en: Every time a character releases a skill, the character's attack  will increase by 3%, and critical damage will increase by 10%, which can be stacked up to 6 times and lasts for 8 seconds.
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640011.tw: 角色每次釋放技能時，會使自身攻擊力提高3%，爆傷提高10%，最多可疊加6次，持續8秒。

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640012.cn: 角色每次释放技能时，使所有宠物的技能伤害提高20%，最多可叠加5次，持续10秒。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640012.en: Every time a character releases a skill, the skill damage of all pets is increased by 20%, which can be stacked up to 5 times and lasts for 10 seconds.
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640012.tw: 角色每次釋放技能時，使所有寵物的技能傷害提高20%，最多可疊加5次，持續10秒。

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640013.cn: 每10秒会随机扔出一个骰子，角色头顶会出现一个骰子，根据骰子投出的数量，骰子数字每高一点，所有召唤物造成的伤害提高8%，持续8秒。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640013.en: A dice will be randomly thrown every 10 seconds, and a dice will appear above the character's head. According to the number of dice thrown, the damage caused by all summoned objects will increase by 8% for each higher dice number, which lasts for 8 seconds.
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640013.tw: 每10秒會隨機扔出一個骰子，角色頭頂會出現一個骰子，根據骰子投出的數量，骰子數字每高一點，所有召喚物造成的傷害提高8%，持續8秒。

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640014.cn: 武器造成伤害时有1%的几率将所有敌人变成煤球，持续5秒，敌人变成煤球后无法攻击，受到的伤害提高10%且移动速度降低50%，冷却时间10秒。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640014.en: When the weapon deals damage, there is a 1% chance to turn all enemies into briquettes for 5 seconds. After the enemy turns into briquettes, they cannot attack, the damage received is increased by 10% and the movement speed is reduced by 50%. The cooldown  time is 10 seconds.
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640014.tw: 武器造成傷害時有1%的幾率將所有敵人變成煤球，持續5秒，敵人變成煤球後無法攻擊，受到的傷害提高10%且移動速度降低50%，冷卻時間10秒。

excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640015.cn: 所有单位每存活20秒，就会让伤害提高5%，最多叠加3层。
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640015.en: For every 20 seconds, every characters are still alive, damage will be increased by 5%. Stack up to 3 times
excel_DungeonSpEffect_desc_1640015.tw: 所有單位每存活20秒，就會讓傷害提高5%，最多疊加3層。
